hash_method: Read each recorded object with git cat-file --batch; byte count is Git blob length; verify SHA-1 of b'blob '+ASCII length+b'\0'+bytes equals object ID; compute SHA-256 of blob bytes. No working-tree newline or Unicode normalization.
selection_note: Every product and published file, direct data inputs, comparison outputs, historical inputs, prior evidence, governance and full py implementation tree. implementation_tree is deliberately a conservative source dependency set, not a claim that every module executes. Exact direct data input and expected output memberships are named per command. Runtime file/mode/mtime measurements belong to the executing 6B-6E task; this is a Git baseline, not a regeneration claim.

runtime_verification_protocol: Before each generator, verify HEAD, index, all exact input blobs and existing output bytes against this baseline or an explicitly accepted intervening commit.

Snapshot st_mtime_ns, size, raw SHA-256 and Git-equivalent blob identity over tracked files plus recursively enumerated non-cache working files. Exclude .git, .venv, .novc, __pycache__, .pytest_cache and .ruff_cache from recursive traversal; keep tracked paths even inside an excluded directory.

Assert os.path.lexists is false for all five exact C:/Users/BenDe/GitRepos/<product> sibling paths both before and after each command. Snapshot the MAM-basics root, not only the expected output subdirectory, to detect unexpected target writes.

Compare every expected artifact even when a conditional writer leaves its mtime unchanged. Record actual changed path lists separately from expected output sets. Report new, missing, or unclassified writes and inspect every byte change before accepting it.

Protect every historical/static/input blob and prior manifest. Never normalize external or historical text, regenerate a frozen oracle to pass a diff, or infer regeneration coverage from a clean git status.
For raw working-byte versus Git-blob differences, inspect declared EOL attributes and record the exact transformation separately; do not silently normalize comparisons.
